long_biography.plain_text:
Les Eck grew up around the Kansas Ford dealership founded by his father. He studied business at Wichita State University, then gained operating experience by managing and owning a Ford-Lincoln-Mercury store in Leavenworth. After returning to the Wichita area in 1983, he pursued several small ventures before acquiring Rusty Eck Ford from his father in 1997.

As president and owner, Eck modernized the flagship, developed a new Wichita facility and expanded the family business into additional franchises across Kansas and Missouri. He also established Adopt-A-School, which organizes business participation in school support. Its fundraising helps teachers purchase classroom books, supplies and equipment.
